Update a user's status to 'suspended'. A suspended user cannot log into the platform. Suspending a user stops their running workspaces; activating the user again does not restart them.

## Usage

```console
coder users suspend [flags] <username|user_id>
```

## Description

```console
 coder users suspend example_user
```
